title: Bound release tracing and preserve environment setup templates
summary: Limit build tracing to the release checkout and exclude generated build/audit files and nested projects while retaining all local recovery data.

changes.detail: Set outputFileTracingRoot to the application directory to avoid tracing the parent workspace.
Include existing credential-free environment templates for explicit environment isolation and disabled-by-default SEO workers.
Exclude generated development bundles, nested release worktrees, unrelated project gitlink and audit helper files from publication only; local copies and recovery work are preserved.

validation.name: Secret and merge scan
validation.detail: Candidate scan found no known secret values, credential-pattern matches or conflict markers.

validation.detail: Final build, complete Node 24 test run, typechecks and deployment are pending. Build preparation encountered disk exhaustion; only temporary copies created this turn were removed.
